what: The add-page and app-shell recipes match the scaffold `init` writes, `init`'s entry is stated once, and the generated docs print whole, deduplicated signatures.

packages/basalt-ui/scripts/gen-docs.ts, its tests and baseline, and the generated packages/basalt-ui/docs/**
